verdict_rationale: This analysis is a SLOPE-ONLY PRE-ATTRIBUTION NOTE, not a definitive verdict. No attribution lab artifacts exist for this run: no start/midpoint/end heap profiles, no memstats checkpoints, unknown heap_objects_delta, unknown top_allocators. The midpoint math (Start→Mid: 369.4 KiB/min, Mid→End: 352.4 KiB/min, ratio 0.954) shows CONTINUED GROWTH at 95.4% of first-half rate - NOT a plateau. Long-window slope being lower than short-window slope proves the 10s window was warmup-sensitive, but does NOT prove the 906s run plateaued. True verdict requires attribution artifacts from a 30-60 min lab run with forced-GC checkpoints.
